internalOnlySurfaces.reason: Persistence records are implementation details; public resources use stable projections.
Storage topology stays private; access is granted through bounded signed operations.
Materialized renderer plaintext is worker-only; public contracts expose references and hashes.
Provider credentials are opened only by infrastructure adapters and are never serialized publicly.
Raw prompts may contain untrusted or sensitive content; public contracts expose redacted evidence.
Worker lease tokens are one-shot fencing secrets and must remain process-local.
